helpdesk.title: Help Desk
helpdesk.heroSubtitle: Tap any topic below to expand steps. You can open Live Chat directly from Settings.
helpdesk.trackingStep1: Open the Children tab and select your child.
helpdesk.trackingStep2: Tap Live Tracking on the child details screen.
helpdesk.trackingStep3: Use Retry Check if location data does not refresh.
helpdesk.notificationsStep1: Confirm app notification permission is enabled.
helpdesk.notificationsStep2: Disable battery optimization for this app.
helpdesk.notificationsStep3: Make sure mobile data or Wi-Fi is active.
helpdesk.notificationsStep4: Pull down to refresh the Notifications tab.
helpdesk.notificationsStep5: Log out and sign in again to refresh your session.
helpdesk.billingStep1: Refresh the Billing tab after making a payment.
helpdesk.billingStep2: If a payment fails but money is deducted, wait a few minutes and check again.
helpdesk.billingStep3: Share the transaction reference with admin if the status remains incorrect.
helpdesk.accessTitle: No access to Billing or Notifications
helpdesk.accessStep1: Your account must have at least one student assigned by admin.
helpdesk.accessStep2: Contact admin and request student assignment to your account.
helpdesk.accessStep3: Tap Retry Check after assignment to refresh access.
